diff --git a/fs/bcachefs/btree_cache.c b/fs/bcachefs/btree_cache.c
index 91e0aa796e6b..555048a7227b 100644
--- a/fs/bcachefs/btree_cache.c
+++ b/fs/bcachefs/btree_cache.c
@@ -209,6 +209,9 @@ static inline bool __btree_node_pinned(struct btree_cache *bc, struct btree *b)
 
 	u64 mask = bc->pinned_nodes_mask[!!b->c.level];
 
+	if (b->c.btree_id > BTREE_ID_NR_MAX)
+		return false;
+
 	return ((mask & BIT_ULL(b->c.btree_id)) &&
 		bbpos_cmp(bc->pinned_nodes_start, pos) < 0 &&
 		bbpos_cmp(bc->pinned_nodes_end, pos) >= 0);
